name: Links on request
description: Tools that send x-subscription-format: links get share links whatever their UA. Enable if your tooling uses it.

name: Happ iOS (Xray JSON, NE memory)
description: iOS Network Extension ~50 MB. no-limit-enabled is a beta Advanced parameter: it needs providerid (global header).

name: INCY iOS (Xray JSON, NE memory)
description: INCY documents no-limit-enabled as an enable-only memory-tight NE mode.

name: Happ / INCY Android (Xray JSON, fewer hosts)
description: Same host set as iOS for phones.

name: Happ 4+ / INCY (Xray JSON)
description: Explicit, so it does not depend on serveJsonAtBaseSubscription.

name: Throne desktop 1.2+ / Android 2+ (Xray JSON array)
description: Each array element becomes a Custom Xray Config named from remarks. Older Throne: links.

name: OneXray (Xray JSON)
description: UA starts with v2rayN/ on purpose: must stay above the v2rayN rule.

name: v2rayNG 1.8.29+ (Xray JSON)
description: Template must contain a routing key, or v2rayNG does not take it as a full config.

name: v2rayN 6.40+ (Xray JSON)
description: 3-part version and nothing after it: excludes Passwall2's default v2rayN/9.99.

name: Other Xray JSON clients
description: Streisand, V2Box (Remnawave: all versions), Wrabbit (operator-observed), v2plus.

name: GUI.for.SingBox default UA
description: Sends exactly clash.meta/mihomo by default but only reads sing-box JSON outbounds.

name: Mihomo Clients
description: Must stay above ^clash, or these get CLASH and lose XHTTP. Adds ClashX Meta (%20) and Clash Mi to the default.

name: Stash (iOS, macOS)
description: Response with generated YAML config (Stash Template)

name: Sing-box clients
description: SFA/SFI/SFM/SFT plus SFW/SFL (desktop, 1.14) and bare SFM (DeskBox); karing anywhere. Hiddify and husi are deliberately not here: they are better with links.

name: Clash Core Clients
description: Whatever is left that starts with clash: ClashforWindows (also Murge), legacy builds.

name: v2RayTun (Xray JSON, opt-in)
description: Release notes mention JSON with balancers; unverified. No version in the UA, so no gate.
